title: lwp Gate record
description: A gate is an owner action with an entry condition, not a build deliverable, so it has no author/checked_by/commands triple to prove. It records what an independent verifier checked and the verdict. Phase records (proof/LWP-D*.json) use proof/schema.json instead; scripts/lwp_check_proof.py routes by filename. See proof/README.md.

gate.description: The gate id from docs/requirements/plan.md, e.g. G-PUB.

item.description: Which entry condition of the gate this record covers.

date.description: ISO date the check was run.

verifier.description: Identity of the independent verifier. A gate record is worthless if the session that did the work also signed it off.

id.description: Short slug for the individual check.

result.description: The check's outcome. A record carrying any 'fail' cannot have verdict 'publishable' — enforced in scripts/lwp_check_proof.py.

detail.description: What was actually examined and what was found. Not a restatement of the id.

files.description: Optional: the specific paths this check covered.
